```python
slope = Fraction(2) - a1         # f'(1)
# tangent: y = slope*(x-1) + f1

# f'(x) = ln x + 1 + 1/x - a, f''(x) = 1/x - 1/x^2 > 0 for x > 1,
```

```python
import unicodedata as U

N = lambda s: U.normalize("NFC", s)
data = [
    ("tmi’gn", "dəmīgən"),
    ("an’stawteg", "anəstawtek"),
    ("gjiansale’wit", "əkciansalēwit"),
    ("mgumie’jo’tlatl", "əmkumiējōdəladəl"),
    ("amqwanji’j", "amxʷancīc"),
    ("e’jnt", "ējənt"),
    ("tplutaqan", "ətpəludaɣan"),
    ("ge’gwising", "gēgʷisink"),
    ("lnu’sgw", "lənūskw"),
    ("g’p’ta’q", "gəbədāx"),
    ("epsaqtejg", "epsaxteck"),
]
LONG = {"ā": "a", "ē": "e", "ī": "i", "ō": "o", "ū": "u"}
CONS = {"d": "t", "b": "p", "g": "g", "k": "g", "c": "j", "x": "q", "ɣ": "q",
        "ʷ": "w", "t": "t", "p": "p", "m": "m", "n": "n", "l": "l", "s": "s",
        "w": "w", "j": "j"}
def translit(ph):
    ph = N(ph)
    out = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(ph):
        if ch == "ə":
            nxt = ph[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(ph) else ""
            if i == 0 or nxt in "lmn":
                continue          # schwa left unwritten
            out.append("’")
        elif ch in LONG:
            out.append(LONG[ch] + "’")
        elif ch in "aeiou":
            out.append(ch)
        else:
            out.append(CONS[ch])
    return "".join(out)

ok = True
for o, p in data:
    t = translit(p)
    good = (t == N(o))
    ok &= good
    print(o, p, "->", t, "OK" if good else "MISMATCH")
print("rules reproduce all data:", ok)

target = "alaptək"
pred = translit(target)
sub = N("alapt’k")
print("predicted:", pred, "| submitted:", sub)
print("any 'k' in orthography of data:", any("k" in N(o) for o, _ in data))
print("CHECK PASS" if pred == sub else "CHECK FAIL")
```
